response.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_averages), above_average AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.all_equipment_avg), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS group_avg FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - a.all_equipment_avg AS above_all_equipment_avg, a.avg_humidity - g.group_avg AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE a.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean IS NULL, difference_from_group_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
